name: appwrite
description: The open-source cloud for agents & devs. Including Auth, Databases, Storage, Functions, Messaging, Hosting, Realtime, WAF and more
one_liner: A ready-made backend (logins, databases, file storage, notifications) you can self-host or use in the cloud so you don't have to build server infrastructure from scratch.
buyer: A solo app developer or small startup that needs a backend fast but doesn't want to hire backend engineers or pay enterprise cloud prices.
business_use_cases: An indie app developer builds a mobile app's entire backend (auth, database, file storage) on Appwrite in days instead of months.
An agency standardizes client projects on self-hosted Appwrite to avoid per-client AWS bills and speed up delivery.
A startup building an AI agent product uses Appwrite's MCP integration to give its agents direct, safe access to app data.

money_ideas.idea: Offer 'launch your app backend in a week' packaged consulting for non-technical founders, built on Appwrite.
Run managed, white-labeled Appwrite hosting for small agencies' client apps.

steal_this: Pick a simple app idea (e.g. a booking app for local businesses), build its entire backend on self-hosted Appwrite this weekend, and sell it as a done-for-you SaaS.
